mark-zuckerberg-muse.name: Mark Zuckerberg
mark-zuckerberg-muse.title: Muse: Personal Superintelligence for Everyday Use
mark-zuckerberg-muse.summary: Mark Zuckerberg discusses Meta’s plans to make personal superintelligence widely available, covering Muse’s uses and pricing, privacy for personal agents, and AI research and safety.

shin-jeongkyu-astra.name: Jeongkyu Shin
shin-jeongkyu-astra.title: What Remains for AI Companies After Astra?
shin-jeongkyu-astra.summary: Jeongkyu Shin examines how iterative computation within models, inference hardware, and lower development costs are shifting AI companies’ competitive advantages after Astra.

masayoshi-son-asi-economy.name: Masayoshi Son
masayoshi-son-asi-economy.title: Preparing for the ASI Economy of 2040
masayoshi-son-asi-economy.summary: Masayoshi Son discusses an economy shaped by AI agents and humanoid robots in 2040, the power and computing infrastructure it requires, and a new business metric called Return on AI.

tibo-ai-wave.name: Tibo
tibo-ai-wave.title: Understanding the Next AI Wave Early
tibo-ai-wave.summary: Tibo argues that personal agents, voice interfaces, ultrafast inference, and self-improvement will make the next wave of AI fit more naturally into people’s lives.

sam-altman-startup-school-2026.name: Sam Altman
sam-altman-startup-school-2026.title: No Better Time to Start a Company
sam-altman-startup-school-2026.summary: Sam Altman and Garry Tan discuss starting companies in the AI agent era, convictions that challenge conventional wisdom, safety, decentralizing power, and a future that preserves freedom.

liao-heng.name: Liao Heng
liao-heng.title: A Semiconductor Researcher’s Field Notes
liao-heng.summary: Drawing on the development history of Huawei’s Ascend, Liao Heng argues that competition in AI chips hinges not on individual chips but on economically sustainable co-design across the supply chain, software, and wider ecosystem.

liang-wenfeng.name: Liang Wenfeng
liang-wenfeng.title: Restraint in Pursuit of AGI
liang-wenfeng.summary: Liang Wenfeng argues that open source and keeping profits reasonable offer better prospects for achieving AGI through continual learning than pursuing short-term commercialization.

yang-zhilin.name: Yang Zhilin
yang-zhilin.title: At the Beginning of Infinity
yang-zhilin.summary: Yang Zhilin discusses K2’s reinforcement learning and a general-purpose agent strategy, viewing AI as a tool that amplifies problem-solving to expand the boundaries of knowledge and civilization.
